v1_0_evidence_or_failure: 13B informed rankers tied and shared order
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Ranking benchmark must create orthogonal conflicts between frequency, transfer evidence, reuse, and true held-out usefulness
validation_check: Before outcomes, development diagnostics show different orderings among required rankers; confirmatory candidates/seeds locked

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: 13C all 44/44 candidates selected
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: SCT benchmark must impose fixed capacity below candidate count and include decision-relevant alternatives
validation_check: Selection log proves at least one rejection/acceptance choice; all-candidate selection invalidates superiority comparison

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: No explicit good/neutral/bad candidate pressure in 13C
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Candidate pool must include independently labeled positive-, neutral-, and negative-value candidates; preserve user target of >=20% each or documented equivalent
validation_check: Labels derive from held-out outcomes not used by selection policy; distribution checked on development data

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: Random-create p=1.0 and policies degenerate
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Random baselines must be nondegenerate and seeded; verify random policy does not collapse to always-create
validation_check: Preflight selection overlap report and RNG/seed audit

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: SCV association not incremental over frequency/p_reuse
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: SCV must compete against frequency, reuse, always, and random on held-out candidate outcomes
validation_check: Primary paired decision-value contrast and independent replication; report each signal separately

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: Memory-only strong but applications unmatched
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Memory, abstraction, hybrid, and no-learning arms must share data access, storage, retrieval, action, and compute budgets
validation_check: Budget parity audit plus exact-replay leakage test

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: No direct novel-composition challenge to memory
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Memory benchmark must separately include exact replay, unseen recombination of seen components, context shift, composition shift, and partial analogy
validation_check: Per-family task IDs and success denominators locked before evaluation

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: Frequency and transfer signals may align on tested pool
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Ranking conflict design must include frequent useful/useless, rare useful/useless, transfer-rich/poor cases without using test labels at ranking time
validation_check: Independent ground-truth usefulness measured only after ranking; policy divergence verified on dev

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: 13D transfer categories uneven and component coverage missing
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Transfer taxonomy and eligibility rules must be predeclared; unavailable cells remain unavailable and source coverage is reported
validation_check: Task-level source-skill coverage table and near/moderate/far/structural/negative denominators

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: Negative-transfer guard evidence limited
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Separate forced negative probes, natural negative outcomes, guard decisions, and false positives
validation_check: Report prediction decrement, exact accuracy decrement, guard sensitivity/specificity separately

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: CGR internal and one capability persists
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Capability validation target must be external to CGR/IG formulas and independently observable
validation_check: Target is held-out novel-task breadth/success/persistence; no shared score components

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: C_t→utility is tiny same-cohort association
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Capability prediction must be out-of-sample and incremental beyond prior ability, exposure, and simple counts
validation_check: Locked prediction split, external criterion, baseline comparisons and cluster-aware uncertainty

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: IG formula lacks independent criterion; IE trends negative
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Intelligence validation target must not reuse IG components and must measure future learning/adaptation
validation_check: Predefine external target; compare IG incremental predictive validity to baseline and experience

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: Single-generator synthetic dependence
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: At least two independent generators/vocabulary shifts and distinct trace implementation are required for general claims
validation_check: Replicate frozen effects without tuning to test generator

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: ARC demo-fit coverage conflated with accuracy
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Report ingestion, DSL demo-fit coverage, successful traces, invariant/skill/capability counts, transfer denominator, and exact task accuracy as separate metrics
validation_check: Table schema includes units/denominators and scored budgets; automated assertion prevents conflation

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: 13G frozen budget 3 but discover() uses 10
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: One source-of-truth budget must match config, discovery, coverage and scored-arm stages; any intentional stage difference named and frozen
validation_check: Runtime per-task trial logs equal declared budget; hash config/code; deviations block confirmatory run

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: 13G discovered only three traces; support gates not met
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: ARC coverage audit must precede invariant/skill claims; downstream metrics marked unavailable if prerequisites absent
validation_check: Coverage measured on development and locked heldout task IDs; no posthoc threshold changes

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: Baseline implementations differ across phases
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Freeze each baseline algorithm, eligibility pool, task access, budget and version; do not treat B2/B3/B4 names as identical across phases
validation_check: Baseline matrix and code hash included in every preregistration

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: Compression comparison is proxy, not canonical DreamCoder
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Label compression-inspired methods precisely and define executable algorithm
validation_check: Reproduce baseline from public specification and common budget; no canonical label without full implementation

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: Ablations may alter metric pathway rather than behavior
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Each ablation must preserve all non-target components and include task-level behavior outcome; mark score-only contrasts separately
validation_check: Code diff/component audit and behavioral manipulation check

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: Multiple endpoints and posthoc correction lineage
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: One primary endpoint and decision rule per RQ; secondary/exploratory endpoints labeled; analysis locked before confirmation
validation_check: Preregistration hash and timestamp; no post-result endpoint switching

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: Small seed/candidate counts and clustered rows
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Sample size/power planned at independent unit; candidate/task rows nested correctly; report cluster counts
validation_check: Power/precision simulation and cluster-aware estimator checked pre-run

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: Phase13G same holdout retry
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: No same holdout may be used after outcome exposure; software failure after prediction access requires new locked evaluation split
validation_check: Provenance lock, outcome-access log, attempt records

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: MC cost sensitivity affects net value
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Freeze and justify cost calibration; report utility components and prespecified sensitivity analysis
validation_check: Cost model published before outcomes and same across arms

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: Phase12 planning/checklist can be mistaken for evidence
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Separate software acceptance from empirical claim acceptance in all reports
validation_check: Every claim links to a run-level dataset/report; design documents tagged as non-empirical

v1_0_evidence_or_failure: Competition deadline can drive scope inflation
mandatory_v1_1_requirement: Do not claim v1.1 results before they exist; separate v1.0 submission from future research and use current Kaggle rules
validation_check: Paper includes accurate run provenance, leaderboard ID if entered, and no unrun v1.1 claims
